rationale: No change. I checked one last candidate — whether a follower can forward a ReadIndex between two nodes that each believe the other is leader — and the monotone-term argument rules it out: a node that believes leaderID=X is a follower, X claiming leadership requires a heartbeat at a higher term, and a node that later wins an election sets its own leaderID, so two nodes cannot simultaneously hold stale mutual leadership beliefs to loop messages between. Nothing in that trace changes any recorded account, and the run has reached its closing budget, so the record stands.
